adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { ... })` with no error handler. Unlike the `save()` action (which has `.catch(popupAjaxError)`), a failed DELETE request would not trigger a popup and no recovery/feedback is implemented in this component. The host row is only removed on the `then` path (`sendAction('deleteHost', ...)`), so on failure it remains in place with no UI indication of what happened.
